diagnosis: The SSE route streams live vitals (heart rate, arterial pressure, SpO2) for patientId without checking if req.user is an assigned ICU attending clinician for that patient. Any hospital worker with network credentials can monitor physiological telemetry of any patient.
exploit_request:
GET /api/icu/patients/pat_icu_bed_14/telemetry HTTP/1.1
Host: telemetry.hospital.internal
Authorization: Bearer <general_staff_jwt>
Accept: text/event-stream
